title: Babson, Louis Witten and Bryce DeWitt gravity institutes
place_text: Johns Hopkins; University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill

tellings.quote: Babson contacted Louis Witten, who was coming out of Johns Hopkins,

plain: In the 1950s a man named Babson is said to have reached out to the physicist Louis Witten, then coming out of Johns Hopkins University, and to have helped start gravity research efforts involving Witten and another physicist, Bryce DeWitt, at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. The researcher Eric Weinstein tells this, without naming a source, in an episode about claims of antigravity aircraft. He raises it because private money flowing into gravity research then could point to a hidden interest in controlling gravity.
